stories.headline: PowNed drops 4-part hardstyle documentary HARD
stories.summary: Dutch broadcaster PowNed released all four episodes of HARD on NPO Start on Oct 29, tracing hardcore and hardstyle from late-80s illegal raves to global phenomenon. Pioneers DJ Rob, Paul Elstak and The Prophet feature throughout.

stories.headline: Dr. Peacock drops Frenchcore flip of Mecano classic
stories.summary: Dutch Frenchcore pioneer Dr. Peacock has released his rework of Mecano's 'Hijo de la Luna', a track he's loved since childhood. The release follows its live debut at Harmony of Hardcore and is now on all streaming platforms.

stories.headline: FCKNYE Festival 2026 spans 3 days of hard dance in Brussels
stories.summary: FCKNYE Festival returns Dec 30–Jan 1 at Brussels Expo with Angerfist, Rebelion, Rooler & more across 5 stages. The event has grown from 2,000 attendees in 2010 to 75,000 visitors today.

stories.headline: Phuture Noize & B-Front Drop New 'White Noise' Concept
stories.summary: Phuture Noize and B-Front are joining forces again for 'White Noise', a brand-new live act debuting at Poppodium 013 in Tilburg on March 13. Tickets go on sale November 5 at 19:00 CET via pre-registration only.

caption: A hardstyle doc, a Frenchcore flip, a 3-day Brussels fest & a brand new concept — this week went OFF 🔥
